## Why KaTeX 0.19.1 is rejected

The source PR's CI failed at `npm ci` with:

```
npm error code ERESOLVE
npm error While resolving: @tiptap/extension-mathematics@3.33.1
npm error Found: katex@0.19.1
npm error peer katex@"^0.16.4 || ^0.17.0 || ^0.18.0" from @tiptap/extension-mathematics@3.33.1
```

`@tiptap/extension-mathematics@3.33.1` was re-checked and still declares
`^0.16.4 || ^0.17.0 || ^0.18.0`, so the `katex >= 0.19` bound recorded in
`.github/dependabot.yml` is still correct and was not lifted. The other 18
updates in the group are unaffected and were taken.

## Why Dependabot kept proposing KaTeX 0.19

Dependabot reads `.github/dependabot.yml` from the default branch, `main`. The
fork's `main` (`919d41f`) carries only the `eslint` ignore rule; the reviewed
TypeScript, KaTeX, ts-fsrs and gradle/actions bounds and the Vitest grouping
exist only on `release/note-baseline-prod` and on this branch. The companion
repair `chore/dependabot-config-main-20261027` (`ac325f58`) is already pushed
and is a direct child of `origin/main`, changing only
`.github/dependabot.yml` (+23/-1). It still has to reach `main` for the bounds
to take effect. Until then, expect the same incompatible group to be proposed
again.

## Conflict handling

- `web/server/realtime-proxy` (#116): one hunk each in `package.json` and the
  lockfile, both the `@supabase/supabase-js` range. Resolved to 2.119.0.
- `web` (#118): 29 lockfile hunks, all verified to be only the
  `@typescript-eslint` 8.72.0 -> 8.72.2 bump plus `postcss` 8.5.31 -> 8.5.32.
  Resolved toward the PR. `@typescript-eslint/parser` lands at 8.72.2, which is
  what plugin 8.72.2's peer range requires.
- `web` (#119): 2 `package.json` hunks and 9 lockfile hunks. The lockfile had
  auto-merged `node_modules/katex` to 0.19.1 outside the conflict markers; that
  entry was restored to 0.18.11 so the lockfile agrees with `package.json`.
  `@google/genai` stayed at 2.31.0 rather than taking the PR's 2.30.0.

The lockfile mixes `registry.npmjs.org` and `registry.npmmirror.com` URLs. That
predates this branch and was left alone.

## Acceptance boundaries

These results establish local dependency, type, lint, format, build and test
compatibility on top of `validation/note4`. Remote CI on this combined branch,
the Vercel preview for #118, browser and manual UI acceptance, real provider
behaviour and physical-device acceptance have not been run. No production
database, deployment, firmware, `main` or `release/note-baseline-prod` branch was
changed, and nothing has been pushed.
